declaration.preface:
BR Agrotech Limited is committed to integrating sustainability into its procurement practices to promote responsible sourcing, environmental stewardship, and ethical labor standards. We recognize that sustainable procurement is vital for minimizing environmental impact, ensuring fair labor conditions, and maintaining business resilience. By collaborating with responsible suppliers and adhering to international best practices, we aim to build a supply chain that upholds sustainability, transparency, and accountability.

This policy outlines our commitments to responsible sourcing, supplier engagement, ethical labor practices, and resource efficiency. Through proactive supplier assessments, regular monitoring, and continuous improvements, we seek to enhance supply chain sustainability and drive positive environmental and social outcomes.
declaration.declaration: BR Agrotech Limited is dedicated to responsible procurement practices that align with environmental, social, and governance (ESG) principles. We adhere to global sustainability standards to ensure that our suppliers and business partners comply with ethical labor practices, minimize environmental impact, and support sustainable growth. This policy reinforces our commitment to sustainable sourcing, fair trade, and supply chain transparency.
declaration.scope: This policy applies to BR Agrotech Limited’s operations, , and it covers following sites and all its employees, workers, subcontractors and other stakeholders:

focusAreas: Local supplier and small business support

Responsible sourcing: Source raw materials and products responsibly, prioritizing environmentally friendly and ethically produced goods.
Promote responsible sourcing by prioritizing suppliers with strong environmental management systems.
Source 50% of raw materials from certified sustainable suppliers by FY 2029-30.
Fair labor practices: Ensure fair labor practices across the supply chain, including fair wages, safe working conditions, and non-discrimination policies.
Promote ethical sourcing by conducting supplier training programs on human rights and workplace safety.
Supplier transparency and compliance: Foster transparency in supplier relationships and require compliance with sustainability standards.
Implement a supplier sustainability rating system to assess and improve supplier ESG performance.
Supplier assessment and auditing: Engage in continuous supplier assessments and audits to monitor compliance with sustainable procurement practices.
Conduct human rights and labor compliance audits for 100% of key suppliers by FY 2029-30.
Environmental footprint reduction: Reduce the environmental footprint of procurement activities by optimizing transportation and logistics.
Achieve 25% reduction in Procurement-related carbon emissions per ton of production by FY 2029-30 through optimized logistics and supplier engagement.
Local supplier and small business suppor: Support local suppliers and small businesses to promote economic sustainability within the community.
Partner with three sustainability-focused organizations to enhance responsible procurement initiatives by FY 2029-30.
Energy efficiency and waste reduction: Encourage suppliers to adopt energy-efficient and waste reduction practices.
Increase the procurement of biodegradable and recyclable packaging materials to 65% by FY 2029-30.
Circular economy and resource efficiency: Ensure that procurement decisions align with circular economy principles, focusing on resource efficiency and waste minimization.
Support circular economy initiatives by collaborating with suppliers that focus on material reuse and waste reduction.
Promote supplier capacity-building programs, ensuring 100% of suppliers receive sustainability training by FY 2029-30.

policy.monitoring:
The Procurement & Supply Chain Team will monitor supplier ESG performance and report progress annually.

Independent supplier audits and assessments validates compliance with sustainability and ethical procurement standards.
